scripts.text: Welcome to Rock Ridge, the hot, dry desert in the West where adventure is waiting!
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到洛克里奇！这里是西部炎热干燥的沙漠，正等待着冒险者前来探索！

scripts.text: I'm the sheriff's assistant, and I'm here to guide visitors. Is there a place you want to go?
scripts.translation: 我是警长的助手，负责为访客指路。你想去哪里？

scripts.text: Tell me where you want to go, and I'll show you where it is.
scripts.translation: 告诉我你想去的地方，我会为你指路。

scripts.text: Also, you can use ^B9062FNavigation^000000 mode by ^B9062Fclicking the name of the place^000000 I showed to you.
scripts.translation: 此外，你可以^B9062F点击我显示的地点名称^000000来使用^B9062F导航^000000模式。

scripts.text: The ^006400Kafra Employee^000000, got it. Please click the ^0000FFBox icon^000000 on your mini-map.
scripts.translation: ^006400卡普拉员工^000000，知道了。请点击小地图上的^0000FF箱子图标^000000。

scripts.text: I've marked the location of the <NAVI>Inn<INFO>harboro1,156,215,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> on your mini-map.
scripts.translation: 我已在你的小地图上标出<NAVI>旅馆<INFO>harboro1,156,215,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>的位置。

scripts.text: Click the name to activate Navigation mode.
scripts.translation: 点击名称即可开启导航模式。

scripts.text: I've marked the location of the <NAVI>Weapon/Armor Shop<INFO>harboro1,312,193,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> on your mini-map.
scripts.translation: 我已在你的小地图上标出<NAVI>武器/防具商店<INFO>harboro1,312,193,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>的位置。

scripts.text: Click the name to activate Navigation mode.
scripts.translation: 点击名称即可开启导航模式。

scripts.text: I've marked the location of the <NAVI>Tool Shop<INFO>harboro1,312,193,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> on your mini-map.
scripts.translation: 我已在你的小地图上标出<NAVI>道具商店<INFO>harboro1,312,193,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>的位置。

scripts.text: Click the name to activate Navigation mode.
scripts.translation: 点击名称即可开启导航模式。

scripts.text: I've marked the location of the <NAVI>Sheriff's Office<INFO>harboro1,241,218,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> on your mini-map.
scripts.translation: 我已在你的小地图上标出<NAVI>警长办公室<INFO>harboro1,241,218,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>的位置。

scripts.text: Click the name to activate Navigation mode.
scripts.translation: 点击名称即可开启导航模式。

scripts.text: Let me remove all the marks on your mini-map.
scripts.translation: 我来清除你小地图上的所有标记。

scripts.text: Enjoy your stay in Rock Ridge!
scripts.translation: 祝你在洛克里奇玩得愉快！

scripts.text: Is there anywhere else you want to check?
scripts.translation: 还有其他地方想去看看吗？
